previous_assumption: Adding Tailwind CSS to the Next.js 15 web app needs a `tailwind.config.ts` with an explicit `content` glob, per Tailwind's classic (v3) setup docs.
correction: Installed Tailwind v4 instead, which needs no config file: `@tailwindcss/postcss` + `postcss` as devDeps, a two-line `postcss.config.mjs` (`plugins: { "@tailwindcss/postcss": {} }`), and a single `@import "tailwindcss";` at the top of `apps/web/app/globals.css`. Content/class detection is automatic across the project. Verified by grepping the served `/_next/static/css/app/layout.css` for utility classes used only in `apps/web/app/machines/page.tsx` and finding them present.
